tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Returns the live per-car price in GBP for each suitable car (Mercedes E-Class, V-Class, S-Class, Range Rover), computed by Tripyana's own booking form for this exact trip, plus a pre-filled booking link. Prices are per car, all-inclusive. The customer books and pays on the link; this tool never book

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Builds a link to Tripyana's booking form with the trip already filled in; the customer only picks the car, adds contact details and pays. No price lookup.

tools.name: check_flight
tools.description: Looks up a flight number and returns its scheduled arrival airport, time and terminal when available, with the suggested chauffeur pickup time (landing + 45 minutes) for UK arrivals.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Cancellation, airport waiting time, what the price includes, payment and licensing.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Airports and ports covered, hourly chauffeur hire, day trips and VIP airport meet and assist, with page links.
